original: 私の成績は平均より上だよ。

en.text: My grades are above average.

original: 高校時代、数学の成績は惨憺たるものでした。

en.text: My mathematics grades in high school were shameful.

original: 最近ノート取り方を変えて、それから数学に自信がついてきた。例えば、テストの時これまでは、何もわからないから、成績が悪かった。でも、昨日テストをしたら、結果はまだわからないけど、やっと上手くいったと思うよ。

en.text: I recently changed the way I take notes, and ever since then I've gained confidence in math. For example, usually when I take tests, I don't know anything, and I get bad grades. But yesterday I took a test, and although I don't know my score yet, I think it went well for once.

original: どれだけ成績が優秀でも失言が多くて困る。

en.text: No matter how good his grades are, he struggles to keep his foot out of his mouth.

original: 学校の成績は、並でした。

en.text: My school marks were average.

original: 学校の成績は、普通でした。

en.text: My school marks were average.
My grades in school were average.

original: メアリーは成績を上げないとな。

en.text: Mary needs to improve her grades.

original: 学校の成績が良かったら、来年の夏はボストンに行かせてあげるよ。

en.text: If you get good grades at school, I'll let you go to Boston next summer.

original: 学校の成績って良かった？

en.text: Did you do well in school?

original: お前の成績は俺よりいいじゃん。

en.text: Your grades are better than mine.

original: 彼は成績が下がり、焦りを感じていたが、努力を重ねて挽回した。

en.text: His grades had dropped and he felt anxious, but he put in continuous effort and turned things around.
